user.title: Connect Tankarta
user.description: Setup opens `business.tankarta.cz` through Browserless, signs in and captures the native AJAX `POST /Dashboard-ListPrice` sent by the dashboard. Products are created as dynamic price sensors. `divisionID` is discovered automatically and exposed only as the `division_id` attribute of its sensor.

data_description.browserless_url: Browserless base URL or a WebSocket URL already used by a service such as Changedetection.
data_description.browserless_token: Leave empty when the local Browserless instance does not require a token.
data_description.currency: Three-letter ISO 4217 code. The default is CZK. The endpoint does not return a currency or product unit.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tankarta
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the current password. Changing to another account is not allowed; add another integration instance instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Tankarta
reauth_confirm.description: The Tankarta portal rejected the saved credentials.

error.invalid_auth: Tankarta login did not create a valid session. Check the username and password.
error.invalid_currency: Currency must be a three-letter code such as CZK.
error.invalid_data: Tankarta returned incomplete or unexpected price data.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.cannot_connect_browserless: Cannot connect to Browserless, or Browserless returned an invalid response.
error.cannot_connect_portal: Browserless works, but the Tankarta portal cannot be loaded.
error.endpoint_not_found: Login succeeded, but the Tankarta price endpoint was not found or returned an HTTP error.
error.two_factor_required: The Tankarta account requires two-factor authentication, which the integration cannot complete automatically.
error.challenge_required: The Tankarta login page requires an interactive verification challenge or CAPTCHA.
error.login_form_changed: The Tankarta login form changed. Enable debug logging and provide the safe form diagnostics.

abort.already_configured: This Tankarta account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The supplied credentials belong to a different Tankarta account.

init.title: Tankarta price updates and discount
init.description: Set the refresh interval and an optional discount from the announced price. Configure at most one discount method; leave both fields empty to keep the base price.

data_description.discount_amount: A fixed amount subtracted from the announced price.
data_description.discount_percentage: A percentage subtracted from the announced price.

error.discount_both_set: Configure either a discount amount or a discount percentage, not both.
error.invalid_discount_percentage: The discount percentage must be between 0 and 100.
